create_chunk_sharded_tensor: create a function to shard a tensor into chunks along the first dimension and return a ShardedTensor with local shards per rank
create_chunk_dtensor: create a function to shard a tensor into chunks along the first dimension and return a DTensor with FSDP or HSDP placements
all_gather_dtensor: all gather a DTensor in its sharded dimension and return the local tensor by redistributing with Replicate placements
get_remote_device_str: build a function to generate a remote device string for a given rank, device type, and number of devices per node
test_shard_utils: test the FSDP shard utilities for chunking tensors into ShardedTensor and DTensor with correct shard offsets and placements
